headlines.summary: 从券商处了解到，近日，中国证券业协会就《证券业务示范实践第3号——保荐人尽职调查（征求意见稿）》面向证券行业征求意见，意见反馈截至8月25日。这一修订文件超11万字，是对2022年版规定的全面升级，也是近年来资本市场保荐尽调领域体系最完整、细则最翔实的一次规则重构。

headlines.title_en: IPO regulation tightens! Sponsor due diligence rules restructured to crack down on fake innovation and pro forma checks
headlines.summary_en: According to brokers, the Securities Association of China recently solicited industry opinions on the "Securities Business Demonstration Practice No. 3 - Sponsor Due Diligence (Draft for Comments)", with feedback due by August 25. The revised document, exceeding 110,000 characters, is a comprehensive upgrade of the 2022 version and the most complete and detailed rule restructuring in sponsor due diligence in the capital markets in recent years.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 伊朗高官：美试图阻挠伊朗阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡谈判
headlines.summary: 伊朗新闻电视台4日援引一名伊朗高级官员的话报道说，美国政府试图阻挠伊朗与阿曼之间关于霍尔木兹海峡管理的持续谈判。报道说，尽管遭美方阻挠，伊朗与阿曼有关霍尔木兹海峡的谈判已进入“新阶段”。 美国国务卿鲁比奥4日在美国国务院对媒体说，眼下最紧迫、最受关注的问题就是霍尔木兹海峡问题，美方正参与阿曼和伊朗之间的相关对话和谈判，讨论如何在短期内能让更多船只安全通过该海峡。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Iranian official: US trying to obstruct Iran-Oman talks on Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary_en: Iran's Press TV cited a senior Iranian official on the 4th, reporting that the US government is attempting to obstruct ongoing negotiations between Iran and Oman over the management of the Strait of Hormuz. The report said that despite US obstruction, talks between Iran and Oman on the Strait of Hormuz have entered a "new phase". US Secretary of State Rubio told media at the State Department on the 4th that the most urgent and closely watched issue now is the Strait of Hormuz, and the US is participating in relevant dialogues and negotiations between Oman and Iran, discussing how to enable more ships to pass safely through the strait in the short term. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 8台核电新机组获核准，上海核电企业已承揽近500亿元订单
headlines.summary: 7月31日，国务院常务会议决定核准浙江金七门核电二期、广东太平岭核电三期、辽宁庄河核电一期、山东莱阳核电一期4个核电项目，共8台核电机组。这是“十五五”时期首批获准的核电项目，据估算，上述新项目的总投资将超过1700亿元。 据了解，作为我国核电产业的重要承载地，上海核电充分发挥产业链集聚优势，在新获批的8台机组前期项目招标中，上海已承接各类合同金额近500亿元。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: 8 new nuclear power units approved; Shanghai nuclear firms secure nearly 50 billion yuan in orders
headlines.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council executive meeting decided to approve four nuclear power projects: Zhejiang Jinqimen Phase II, Guangdong Taipingling Phase III, Liaoning Zhuanghe Phase I, and Shandong Laiyang Phase I, totaling 8 nuclear power units. These are the first batch of approved nuclear projects in the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, with the total investment of the new projects estimated to exceed 170 billion yuan. It is understood that as an important base for China's nuclear power industry, Shanghai's nuclear power sector, leveraging its industrial chain agglomeration advantages, has already secured nearly 50 billion yuan in various contract amounts in the pre-project tendering for the newly approved 8 units. (The Paper)

headlines.title: 美国政府拟禁止进口中国新型号的数据中心组件，中金：短期情绪面肯定有冲击，但中长期大概率还是雷声大雨点小
headlines.summary: 知情人士透露，美国政府正起草一项禁令，拟禁止进口中国新型号的数据中心组件。 中金公司通信团队表示，短期情绪面肯定有冲击，但中长期大概率还是雷声大雨点小。 中金称，光模块的核心功能是光电信号转换，本身不承担业务数据存储。相比主动设备，其风险边界和攻击能力明显不同。因此，“消息人士援引的FCC安全逻辑”能否成立，以及拟议限制是否符合必要性原则，本身就值得商榷。

headlines.title_en: US government mulls banning imports of new data center components from China; CICC: short-term sentiment hit likely, but medium-to-long term probably much ado about nothing
headlines.summary_en: Sources say the US government is drafting a ban to prohibit imports of new-model data center components from China. CICC's communications team said there will definitely be a short-term sentiment impact, but in the medium to long term, it is likely more bark than bite. CICC noted that the core function of optical modules is photoelectric signal conversion, which does not involve storing business data. Compared to active equipment, their risk boundary and attack capability are clearly different. Therefore, whether the "FCC security logic" cited by the sources holds, and whether the proposed restriction meets the principle of necessity, is itself debatable.

headlines.title_en: UK 2-year gilt yield falls over 7 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (August 4) in late European trading, the UK 10-year government bond yield fell 5.9 basis points, hitting a daily low of 4.893%, continuing to decline since 18:44 Beijing time. The 2-year gilt yield fell 7.4 basis points, hitting a daily low of 4.232%. The 30-year gilt yield fell 4.8 basis points, and the 50-year gilt yield fell 4.4 basis points. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread rose 1.188 basis points to +65.832 basis points.
